# mdBook layout fixture assets

Unmodified `variables.css`, `general.css`, and `chrome.css` from mdBook 0.4.45,
`src/theme/css/`, licensed under MPL-2.0 (see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/rust-lang/mdBook/tree/v0.4.45/src/theme/css

These files preserve the actual sidebar widths, breakpoints and page layout for
local CSS checks. They are only copied into the local demo assets. The fixture
HTML follows the same version's `src/theme/index.hbs` layout containers.
This is not a full mdBook replacement: search, syntax highlighting, theme picker
and sidebar resizing are omitted. Production still uses the pinned mdBook build.
